title: IREN Rallies 6% as Microsoft Signs Off on Horizon 1, NVIDIA Grants Exemplar Cloud Status
excerpt: Microsoft just signed off on IREN's first major AI data center, and NVIDIA piled on with a rare technical designation, sending shares surging. But with $5.8...
content_html:
David Moadel

Thu, August 13, 2026 at 10:21 AM CDT 5 min read

Quick Read

  • IREN surged 6% after Microsoft formally accepted Horizon 1, triggering monthly invoicing under a five-year, $9.7 billion cloud services agreement.

  • NVIDIA's Exemplar Cloud designation validates Horizon 1's AI performance, potentially helping IREN attract hyperscalers beyond Microsoft for its 480MW 2026 capacity target.

  • Peers APLD, CORZ, and WULF didn't match the size of IREN stock's move Thursday, confirming IREN's rally is a company-specific execution win, not a sector rotation.

  • It sounds nuts, but SoFi1 is giving new Active Invest users up to $3,000 in stock for a limited time, and all it takes is a $50 deposit to get started.2 See for yourself (Sponsor)

IREN (NASDAQ:IREN) shares are up 6% to $46.42 in Thursday midday trading after the company said Microsoft (NASDAQ:MSFT) formally accepted the Horizon 1 data center handoff at Childress, Texas. NVIDIA (NASDAQ:NVDA) separately granted the same deployment "Exemplar Cloud" status, layering a technical validation on top of the commercial milestone.

The move is a meaningful slice of IREN's 2026 return. IREN stock was up 15.62% year to date through the Aug. 12 close, and a 6% single-day gain adds to that base.

The rally reads as a company-specific event. Peers pursuing similar Bitcoin (CRYPTO:BTC) mining-to-AI pivots are not following IREN stock higher today, which frames the reaction as an execution win rather than a sector rotation.

Why Microsoft's Acceptance Changes the Revenue Clock

IREN said Microsoft accepted Horizon 1, a 50MW critical IT load AI cloud deployment built with direct-to-chip liquid cooling and NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 systems. Acceptance matters more than construction completion because it starts the contractual service term.

Under the arrangement, Microsoft has a five-day window to test each GPU deployment against agreed criteria. Once accepted, IREN can begin invoicing Microsoft monthly, which converts a large capital project into recognized revenue rather than work-in-progress.

SoFi Active Invest is offering a limited-time promotion. Open an account, fund it with $50 or more, and you could receive up to $3,000 in complimentary stock for Active Invest accounts. See for yourself by clicking here now.

Horizon 1 is the first of four 50MW deployments due in 2026 under a five-year, $9.7 billion cloud services agreement announced in November 2025. Once fully commissioned, the contract is expected to produce roughly $1.94 billion in annualized run-rate revenue, with a 20% customer prepayment already in place.

  • NVIDIA 的 Exemplar Cloud 称号验证了 Horizo​​n 1 的 AI 性能，可能有助于 IREN 吸引 Microsoft 以外的超大规模企业实现其 2026 年 480MW 容量目标。
  • 同行 APLD、CORZ 和 WULF 与周四 IREN 股票走势的规模不符，证实 IREN 的上涨是公司特定执行力的胜利，而不是行业轮动。
  • 这听起来很疯狂，但 SoFi1 正在限时为新的 Active Invest 用户提供高达 3,000 美元的股票，只需缴纳 50 美元即可开始使用。2 亲自体验（赞助商）

IREN（纳斯达克股票代码：IREN）表示，微软（纳斯达克股票代码：MSFT）正式接受位于德克萨斯州 Childress 的 Horizo​​n 1 数据中心移交，该公司股价在周四午盘交易中上涨 6%，至 46.42 美元。 NVIDIA（纳斯达克股票代码：NVDA）单独授予了相同的部署“Exemplar Cloud”地位，在商业里程碑之上进行了技术验证。

此举是 IREN 2026 年回报的一个有意义的部分。 截至 8 月 12 日收盘，IREN 股价今年迄今已上涨 15.62%，单日涨幅为 6%。

这次集会被视为公司特定的活动。 追求类似比特币（CRYPTO：BTC）挖矿到人工智能枢纽的同行今天并没有跟随 IREN 股票走高，这将这种反应视为执行胜利而不是行业轮动。

为什么微软的接受改变了收入时钟

IREN 表示，微软接受了 Horizo​​n 1，这是一个 50MW 关键 IT 负载人工智能云部署，采用直接芯片液体冷却和 NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 系统构建。 验收比施工竣工更重要，因为验收是合同服务期限的开始。

根据安排，微软有五天的时间根据商定的标准测试每个 GPU 部署。 一旦接受，IREN 就可以开始每月向 Microsoft 开具发票，从而将大型资本项目转换为已确认的收入，而不是在制品。

根据 2025 年 11 月宣布的为期五年、价值 97 亿美元的云服务协议，Horizo​​n 1 是将于 2026 年进行四个 50MW 部署中的第一个。 一旦全面投入使用，该合同预计将产生约 19.4 亿美元的年化运营收入，其中 20% 的客户预付款已到位。
